---
# Hostile fixture: constructs a hand-written graph may contain.
schema_version: 0
id: hostile   # trailing comment on a scalar
name: "Quoted # not a comment"

metadata:
  description: |
    A block scalar that
    spans lines.


inputs:
  message: {type: string, required: true}

nodes:
  # first node
  a:
    type: shell
    config: &shell    # anchor: b reuses this mapping through a merge key
      command: printf
      args: ["%s\n", 'single quoted', plain]   # flow sequence with a comment
    outputs:
      stdout: {type: string}

  b:
    type: shell
    config:
      <<: *shell
      command: "true"
    inputs:
      text: {type: string}

edges:
  # the only edge
  - from: a.outputs.stdout   # source
    to: b.inputs.text

  # a trailing comment inside the sequence
graph_input_bindings: []
outputs: {}
# trailing file comment

metadata.description:
A block scalar that
spans lines.

label: anchors.yaml
